title: Pilot channel contracts
description: The frozen shapes of the REST channel surface (C6): a registered channel, an inbound message that becomes a goal, and an outbound message Pilot delivers. A channel is a REST client — the built-in web page or an external messenger adapter. Adapter service tokens live in secrets_file (C10), never in these shapes.

channel.description: One registered channel (C6): a REST client that may reach the agent.

id.description: Stable channel id, used in the REST path /channels/{id} and as the session key.

outbound_url.description: Where Pilot POSTs outbound messages for this channel; omit for a pull-only adapter.

outbound_secret.description: Name of the secret (in secrets_file) Pilot injects as a bearer header on outbound POSTs to this channel (C10). Omit if the adapter's endpoint is unauthenticated.

allow_from.description: Permitted inbound sender ids. Empty or absent means any sender on this channel.

inboundMessage.description: A message an adapter POSTs to /channels/{id}/messages (C6). If the channel is enabled and the sender is permitted it becomes a goal in the channel's session; otherwise it is refused and never reaches the model.

outboundMessage.description: A message Pilot delivers to a channel (C3 send, or a task's delivery, C11): POSTed to the channel's outbound_url.

task.description: Task id when the message was delivered by a scheduled task (C11).
